description: General Central Commercial District. High-density commercial use with residential allowed. Residential equivalent typically R7-R10. Mixed buildings permitted with separate commercial and residential FAR.

bulk.residential_equivalent: R7 to R10 depending on C6 subdistrict (C6-1 through C6-9)
bulk.commercial_far: Per §33-12 table for commercial FAR; varies by C6 subdistrict
bulk.mixed_building_far: Commercial FAR + residential FAR each separately limited; total shall not exceed greatest single-use FAR per §35-33(d)
bulk.far_note: Verify C6 subdistrict designation — C6-1 (R7) through C6-9 (R10) with corresponding FARs. Community facility follows §33-20.

height_setback.regulation_type: Commercial district height regulations per §33-43; residential portion per §23-43 (if R6-R12 equivalent)
height_setback.notes: Commercial district bulk: street wall location per §33-41, height per §33-43. Mixed buildings: residential portion follows §23-43 or §23-42 depending on equivalency. C1/C2 overlays within C6 follow commercial district provisions.
height_setback.tower_permitted: Yes in higher C6 subdistricts per §33-44 tower regulations

front.requirement: None required in commercial districts for commercial portion; residential portion per R equivalent

rear.requirement: 30 ft required for residential portion; commercial portion per §33-30
rear.note: Mixed buildings: separate yard analysis for commercial and residential

commercial: All Use Groups permitted in C6
residential: Residential permitted in all C6 districts
Pre-1961 buildings exempt from FAR limits
permitted_uses.parking: No front yard requirement for parking; quantity per §36-00

dob_filing_notes: Identify C6 subdistrict (C6-1 through C6-9) — determines residential equivalent and FAR
Mixed buildings: separate commercial and residential FAR analysis required
Verify total combined FAR does not exceed greatest single-use FAR per §35-33(d)
Pre-1961 building conversion: FAR limits waived per §35-31 — document building date
DOB: NB or Alt1. Full commercial and residential analysis for mixed-use
